name: Pool Deck Golden French Fries (Salted Potato Fries)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Pete's Boiler Bites / Disney Magic · Duck-In Diner / Disney Treasure · Mickey's Smokestack
whyItWorks: Skinless white potato strips are low-FODMAP, dairy-free, and citrus-free, though deep-fryer oil requires remission tolerance and small portions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Blot excess fryer oil with a napkin and eat a small side portion while hot; during an active flare, swap for baked/mashed potatoes or white rice.
